stock.description: Hevol Services Group Co. Limited, an investment holding firm operating within the People's Republic of China, specializes in providing comprehensive property management and a wide spectrum of value-added services. The company delivers essential property services such as security, cleaning, landscaping, and general repair and maintenance to property owners, residents, and real estate developers. Its community-focused value-added offerings for property owners include home-living solutions like property upkeep, cleaning, interior renovation, electricity bill collection, shopping assistance, and accommodation and catering. Hevol also generates revenue by leasing communal facilities, such as swimming pools, parking spaces, and advertising locations, to third-party contractors. Furthermore, it fosters community engagement by organizing cultural activities for residents, including sports events, carnivals, elderly care programs, and festive celebrations. The group extends value-added services, encompassing site supervision, auxiliary property management, and full lifecycle and process services, to clients who are not property owners. Management consulting and real estate brokerage services also constitute part of its business activities. Established in Beijing in 2002, Hevol Services Group managed 195 property projects by December 31, 2021, collectively covering a substantial contracted gross floor area of approximately 34.0 million square meters.
